_notes: Model profiles (ADR-040): one OpenAI-compatible endpoint per profile. Prices are USD per 1M tokens on the paid tier; free_tier limits are per project and model. Select with LLM_PROFILE in .env.

budget._note: ADR-023 amended 2026-10-10 (approved by Daniel): engine cap $6.00 under a $7 Google project spend cap, to be set in AI Studio BEFORE billing is enabled (card on file required). Per-company cap is about 4x the measured $0.012 notional per company. The margin keeps us below the free daily limit.
